behaviors.name: Scurry
behaviors.intent: Dart along the wall, pause, dart again.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let phase = time % 6
  if phase < 1.2 then
    self.position = (2.9 + sin(time * 3) * 0.1, 0, -6 - phase * 3.5)
  end
end

behaviors.name: Failing bulb
behaviors.intent: The middle lamp flickers like it is about to die.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  if chance(0.04) then
    self.light.intensity = random(2, 8)
  else
    self.light.intensity = 18
  end
end

behaviors.name: Buzz
behaviors.intent: Neon hums; now and then it stutters.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  if chance(0.012) then
    self.light.intensity = 0.6
  else
    self.light.intensity = 6 + sin(time * 50) * 0.2
  end
end
